summary_bullets: Add a deterministic stall-recovery classifier/report helper with attempt tracking, sanitized public surfaces, allowlist parity linting, and shared larch-dev-clone detection.
Document the Step 18a recovery procedure, retry caps, security sanitization model, and restructure /implement Step 18 into recovery gate plus teardown.
Wire the focused harness into Makefile shards and factor check-stale-plugin.sh onto the shared dev-clone predicate.
commit_message:
Add /implement stall recovery reporting gate

Introduce the stall-recovery report helper, sanitization allowlists, retry-attempt harness, Step 18a recovery prompt, and shared larch dev-clone detection used by both recovery and stale-plugin checks.
todos_left: Live /larch:issue creation was not executed in this restricted environment; dry-run and no-gh behavior are covered by the offline harness.
